text:
Lina: Quick bring-up note for aegis-embed v1 on the onboarding suite. Ran float baseline, int4 symmetric, and int4 + PQ backend. Seeing odd recall@5 behavior when combined with HNSW index. Posting numbers.

Marco: curious 14 what's odd?

Lina: baseline float recall@5=0.774, int4(simple)=0.742, int4+PQ(32 bytes/code)=0.701. But when serving with HNSW efSearch=128 we see recall rise for head queries but tail recall collapses (tail recall@5=0.48).

Sam: that sounds like quantization + ANN search interacting. Do we see average distance shifts or index reranking failure?

Lina: per-query nearest neighbor rank flips correlate with PQ residual variance. For a bad tail query set the L2 quantized distance underestimates separation, so ANN returns noisy neighbors that fail rerank. median cosine float->int4 similarity = 0.961 head, 0.915 tail.

Yuki: did you try increasing PQ codebook or changing product quantization scheme?

Lina: yes: PQ 64-codebook (2x memory) => recall@5 improves to 0.731, tail=0.67. Still not at float but much better. Also tried asymmetric distance compute (ADC) at rerank time => tail up to 0.69.

Marco: any clustering/structure metrics? silhouette, cluster purity? Could be centroid drift making HNSW graph wrong.

Lina: silhouette float=0.29, int4+PQ32=0.22, PQ64=0.26. Cluster purity (kmeans k=200) drops from 0.78->0.70 with PQ32.

Sam: what's the operational cost delta? PQ64 sounds heavier.

Lina: PQ64 increases index size ~1.8x and query RAM working set by ~30%. Latency for topk retrieval + rerank with ADC is +12% vs int4-simple. PQ32 w/o ADC is fastest but worst quality.

Yuki: can we keep int4 for storage but do asymmetric/composite rerank in float for top-500 candidates? tradeoff might be good.

Lina: tried that: store int4+PQ32 on disk, nearest search returns top-512 candidates in int4 space, then reconstruct to fp16 on the fly for rerank => recall@5=0.745, tail=0.69, latency +9% but memory spikes briefly during rerank. Feels like best perf/quality compromise.

Marco: what's the failure mode threshold for rollout gating? we need concrete numbers for model-catalog.

Sam: propose gating rules: overall recall@5 delta <= 0.03 vs float, tail recall@5 delta <= 0.05, median cosine shift <= 0.04. If breached, mark candidate as "needs-compat-mode".

EvalBot: automated eval summary: dataset=semantic-longtail-v2, metrics=[recall@1,recall@5,silhouette,cluster_purity], float={r1:0.608,r5:0.774,sil:0.29,purity:0.78}, int4_simple={r1:0.562,r5:0.742,sil:0.25,purity:0.72}, int4_pq32={r1:0.521,r5:0.701,sil:0.22,purity:0.70}, int4_pq64_adc={r1:0.578,r5:0.731,sil:0.26,purity:0.74}, int4_store_int4_rerank_fp16_top512={r1:0.593,r5:0.745,sil:0.27,purity:0.75}, notes="PQ+ANN interactions hurt tail; recommended: store-int4 + fp16 rerank(top512) as default compatibility profile."

Lina: I'll add the compat profile to model-catalog and include unit tests: two smoke tests (head long-run and tail short-run) and a nightly longtail eval.

Marco: also add an eval that measures per-cluster centroid drift and triggers if centroid cosine shift >0.05 for any cluster with >100 samples.

Yuki: good call. Also include a small qualitative sample of 50 worst-off queries for manual labeling (format: query id, float top3, candidate top3 int4+PQ32).

Lina: will drop that sample and the eval command used.

Lina: command: 
```
rw-eval run --model aegis-embed-v1 --quant-config int4+pq32 --dataset semantic-longtail-v2 --metrics recall@1,recall@5,silhouette,cluster_purity --ann efSearch=128,efConstruction=256 --rerank-mode adc
```

Sam: thanks. After PR, let's run the same config against a small customer anonymized slice to validate production effect before broad rollout.

Lina: agreed. I'll open PR and tag @Marco @Sam for review. :rocket:

Marco: thanks everyone.
